releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.65
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.65**: 7 changes since 0.1.64.

- Reclaim single-resource sidebar title width (#3070)
- Let the iOS keyboard's return stand in for the pinned one (#3068)
- Tuck the phone's Move and Panes toolbar away while typing (#3066)
- Make the phone's New tab a chip like its tabs (#3065)
- Draw the phone composer as one Messages-style row (#3064)
- Tuck the phone's tabs away while typing (#3063)
- Give the phone a native navigation bar and slimmer keys (#3062)

releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.64
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.64**: 1 change since 0.1.63.

- Dictate to a session with the iPhone Action Button (#3057)

releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.63
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.63**: 2 changes since 0.1.61.

- Identify the current split pane without relying on colour (#3055).
- Refresh Developer mode and Labs when Settings opens (#3045).

releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.61
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.61**: 2 changes since 0.1.60.

- Deliberate phone pulls and swipes follow the latest finger position when moves arrive together.
- Payload-free connection diagnostics identify the WebSocket establishment stage where a connection stalls.
